purpose: Canonical categorization and ownership rules for all public and ingested content.

children.exclusiveAudienceRule: All content specifically directed to children or young people belongs under this section regardless of media format or historical subject.

library.rule: Books, editions, scans, EPUB/native texts, audio, video, transcripts and research resources remain resource records and may be cited by multiple content sections without becoming duplicate articles.

editorial.rule: Thematic articles remain in the section determined by their actual subject. Mentioning a person does not convert a thematic article into that person's biography.

ownershipRules.personSpecificBiographicalMaterial: Merge into that person's canonical person.html biography record.
ownershipRules.multiPersonPassage: Assign according to the passage's actual subject and context; create person references for secondary persons rather than duplicating the passage as biography content.
ownershipRules.thematicMaterial: Keep as a separate thematic article when the theme/event is the real subject, and link named people to their canonical biography records.
ownershipRules.legacyNarratorPages: Compatibility routes only; no independent narrator biography corpus.
